@sansa\_grey Fair concern, and honestly the reason we built it the way we did.

Wisry doesn't copy the visuals. It reads the structure of the ad that's working: the hook, the pacing, where the proof lands, how it closes. Then it rebuilds that around your product, your footage or avatar, your palette, your script. Two brands cloning the same source ad end up with two different ads that share a skeleton.

The other thing is the research citation. You see which ads it drew from, so if everyone in your niche is running the same format, you can pick a different source, or have it fan out hook variants instead.

@akbar\_b Hi Akbar, great question. At the moment, generation starts from a single data point, in your case, a single review. The system identifies the one review that best matches your self-defined criteria and builds from there. Steering from higher-level, aggregated insights is on our roadmap, but for now we work with one data entry at a time.

Report

Akbar B [...] How it works

1. Feed in your performance data, brand brain, competitor ads, reviews, and consumer signals. One place, not ten tabs, so research time drops to minutes.

2. Build the workflow once. Every data point after that becomes an ad concept, so you stop starting from scratch every session.

3. Like the concept, skip it, or refine it in plain language. Point out a reference if you've got one. Every choice trains Adomate and saves a version, so getting from 80% to 100% takes minutes, not a new brief.

Why it's different

No black box. Every concept you see traces back to the exact data point that triggered it, the competitor ad, the review line, the performance metric. You can always see why.

Adomate doesn't replace your judgment, it amplifies it.
